ov: ضابط ورجل نبيل (الإنجليزية: An Officer and a Gentleman) هو فيلم دراما تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1982.
plotEn:
After his mother committed suicide, adolescent Zachary "Zack" Mayo was sent to live with his father Byron, an alcoholic, womanizing US Navy petty officer stationed in the Philippines.
Now a college graduate, Zack surprises Byron by telling him he has joined the Navy because he wants to become a jet pilot. He reports to Fort Rainier, an Aviation Officer Candidate School (AOCS) located near Port Townsend, Washington. Upon arriving, Zack and other recruits meet Marine Gunnery Sergeant Emil Foley, their strict, no-nonsense drill instructor. 
Foley tells recruits that only the most capable recruits will become Naval Aviators. Male candidates are warned about "Puget Sound Debs", local girls aspiring to marry a pilot. Soon after, Zack and fellow AOC Sid Worley meet two young factory workers, Paula Pokrifki and Lynette Pomeroy; Zack begins a relationship with Paula while Sid dates Lynette.
Zack is caught peddling contraband uniform accessories needed to pass inspections to his fellow candidates. Foley punishes Zack with rigorous hazing to push him to resign, telling him he lacks the character to be an officer. When Zack refuses to quit, Foley threatens to dismiss him. Zack breaks down and admits that he has no options in civilian life.
